verses.en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.sm: e O le uaina, o le faatauemu lea; o le “ava, o le faapisapisao lea; o i latou uma o e faaseseina ai, e le popoto i latou.

verses.en: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
verses.sm: O le matautia o le tupu, e tusa lea ma le tagi o le leona taanoa; o lé faaonoono ia te ia, e agasala o ia ia te ia lava.

verses.en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.sm: E fai ma viiga o le tagata, ina ua nofo saʻo o ia e le faamisa; a o vale uma, latou te faatuputeleina.

verses.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.sm: E le suatia le eleele e le paie, ona o le tausaga maalili; e aiisi o ia i le tausaga e selesele ai saito, a e le maua.

verses.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.sm: O le atamai i le loto o le tagata, o le vai loloto lea; a o le tagata faautauta, na te utufia mai ai.

verses.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.sm: O le toatele o tagata, e taitasi o i latou ma alagaina lona agalelei; a o ai se na te iloa se tagata faamaoni?

verses.en: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.sm: E savali ma le tonu le ua amiotonu; e manuia lana fanau pe a mavae atu o ia.

verses.en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.sm: O le tupuo loo nofo i le nofoa faamasino; na te faataapeina mea leaga uma i ona fofoga.

verses.en: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.sm: O ai ea se faapea, Ua ou faamamáina loʻu loto; ua tea au ma a'u agasala?

verses.en: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
verses.sm: O maa eseese e fua aЧ, ma efa eseese, e faatau inosia ia mea e lua e le ALII.

verses.en: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.sm: E mafai ona iloa o le tama i lana amio; pe sao ona lelei ma le tonu o lana mea e fai.

verses.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
verses.sm: O taliga e faalogo ai, ma mata e vaai ai; o le ALII o le na faia ia mea e lua.

verses.en: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.sm: Aua e te naunau i le moe, ina neʻi faamativaina ai oe; ia e mataala, e te ma'ona ai i le mea e “ai.

verses.en: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le e faatau, E leaga, e leaga; ua alu ese o ia, ona mitamita ai lea.

verses.en: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.sm: O i ai auro ma penina e tele; a o laugutu e i ai le poto, o le ipu taua lea.

verses.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.sm: Ia e talia le ofu o le ua fai ma moni o le tagata ese; ma ia talia lana mea e tuu faafaatau ona o le tagata ese.

verses.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.sm: E suamalie i le tagata le areto na maua i le pepelo; a e mulimuli ane, ua tumu lona gutu i le iliili.

verses.en: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.sm: E faatumauina mafaufauga i le filifiliga; o le filifili lelei foi ia fai ai taua.

verses.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.sm: Ua faaali upu faalilo le ua fealuai ma feaveaveai; o lea aua neʻi fefaauoai ai ma le ua faamaga pea ona laugutu.

verses.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.sm: O le ua fetuu i lona tama ma lona tinā, e tineia lona lamepa i le pouliuli lava.

verses.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.sm: O le oloa ua maua faataalise i le amataga, e le manuia lea i le gataaga.

verses.en: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
verses.sm: Aua e te faapea ane, Ou te taui atu i le leaga; ia e faatalitali i le ALII, ona faaolaina lea o oe e ia.

verses.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
verses.sm: E inosia e le ALII maa eseese e fua a‘i; o fua faatautau faaaimago e le lelei ia.

verses.en: Man's goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.sm: Mai le ALII le mea e ui atu ai le tagata; o ai ea le tagata na te iloa lona lava ala?

verses.en: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.sm: O le mailei o le tagata pe a tautala taalise i le mea e faasa; a uma foi ana tautoga, ona suesue ai lea e ia.

verses.en: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.sm: E faataapeapeina e ua agasala e le tupu poto; e aumaia foi e ia le mea faataavalevale i o latou luga.

verses.en: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.sm: O le mafaufau o le tagata o le lamepa lea a le Aw;o loo suesue i mea uma i totonu o le loto.

verses.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.sm: O le alofa ma le faamaoni, la te leoleoina le tupu; e faatumauina lona nofoalii i le alofa.

verses.en: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.
verses.sm: O le matagofie O taulelea, o lo latou malosi lea; o le mamalu foi o toeaina, o le ulusinà lea.

verses.en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.sm: O faalavalava o le manua e faamamáina ai le leaga; e faapea foi ta i totonu o le loto.
